# Multiplayer Video

Control a video player with friends using React. Everyone in the activity sees the same playback state.

<Cards>
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
  <Card href="/docs/sync" title="@robojs/sync" description="Real-time state synchronization." />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-multiplayer-video-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- Synchronized video playback
- Play/pause/seek controls
- Real-time state sync across all participants
- TypeScript support

## How It Works

The template uses **[@robojs/sync](/docs/sync)** to synchronize video state across all connected clients. When anyone interacts with the video controls, all participants see the same change.

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
